claims.value: ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B is a multimodal (Text & Vision) Mixture-of-Experts Chat model with 424B total parameters and 47B activated parameters per token. It has 54 layers, 64 Query heads and 8 Key/Value heads. It features 64 text experts with 8 activated and 64 vision experts with 8 activated. Training stage is post-training.
claims.evidence: a multimodal MoE Chat model based on ERNIE-4.5-VL-424B-A47B-Base, with 424B total parameters and 47B activated parameters
supports both thinking and non-thinking modes.
